li.label: satisfyingly very full
li.description: That was a properly indulgent meal. I love this heavy, full feeling.

li.label: delightfully very full
li.description: Stuffed just the way I like it. Every mouthful was worth it.

li.label: ecstatically very full
li.description: Gloriously stuffed. I could hardly have asked for more.

li.label: uncomfortably very full
li.description: Being stuffed this full felt unpleasant and excessive.

li.label: distressingly very full
li.description: I hated feeling so bloated and overstuffed.

li.label: miserably very full
li.description: Reaching such a revolting level of fullness made me miserable.

li.label: enjoyed an after-meal chat
li.description: A good meal, then a lazy chat. A fine way to pass the time.

li.label: enjoyed a shared meal
li.description: Good food tastes even better with company.

li.label: enjoyed being fed
li.description: Someone brought me a meal and stayed to feed me. That felt good.

li.label: enjoyed feeding someone
li.description: Seeing someone enjoy the meal I fed them was its own reward.
